blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Long video generation should keep the subject and background consistent while supporting rich, natural motion. However, autoregressive models are often distilled with distribution matching distillation (DMD) over short windows, which does not train them to keep this consistency over long ranges. As a result, the subject and background can drift over time. Methods that manage the key-value (KV) cache retain or retrieve history to reduce drift. Yet this history may itself have drifted. We propose Reference Forcing, which uses the initial frames as an appearance reference. We first build a teacher that uses attention masks to force each region of a new frame to attend to the same region in the initial frames. The teacher finds these regions with off-the-shelf segmentation models. We then distill this behavior into a separate attention path of the student, which needs no external models at inference. We further introduce value correction, which corrects drifted values in the KV cache toward the matching values of drift-free initial frames. Experiments show that Reference Forcing achieves state-of-the-art subject and background consistency among long-video methods on different base models, and its advantage grows with video length. Ablations show both components are needed to gain consistency without losing motion. More visualizations and code are available at https://zhaosheng-thu.github.io/reference-force/
blocks.zh: 长视频生成应保持主题和背景的一致性,同时支持丰富的自然运动. 然而,自递式模型往往会被分泌相匹配的蒸馏(DMD)于短窗上分泌而分泌出,这并不能训练它们将这种一致性长期地保持下去. 因此,主题和背景可以随时间而漂移. 用于管理密钥值缓存的方法保留或检索历史以减少漂移. 然而,这一历史本身可能已经漂移。 我们建议使用初始框架作为外观参考。 我们首先建立一个教师,使用注意口罩强迫每个区域用新框架在初始框架中照顾同一个区域。 教师发现这些地区有现成的分化模型。 然后我们把这个行为分解成学生的单独关注路径,这不需要外部模型来推断. 我们进一步引入数值校正,将KV缓存中漂移的值校正到无漂移初始帧的匹配值. 实验显示"参考 Forcing"在不同的基础模型上实现了最先进的主题和长视频方法的背景一致性,其优势随着视频长度的增长而增长. 分解显示两个组件都需要在不失去运动的情况下获得一致性. 在https://zhaosheng-thu.github.io/Reference-force/上可找到更多的可视化和编码。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Recent video diffusion models generate short clips with high visual quality [ 1 , 49 , 19 , 40 ] .
Autoregressive video diffusion models extend generation to longer videos by generating one chunk at a time, using previously generated frames to guide each new chunk [ 2 , 55 , 11 , 37 , 3 ] .
With few-step distillation and a key-value (KV) cache that stores recent frames, these models can generate videos lasting a minute or longer in real time [ 48 , 25 , 4 ] .
However, long videos must preserve the appearance of subjects and backgrounds while maintaining rich and natural motion.
In practice, errors accumulate during autoregressive generation, gradually changing the appearance of subjects and backgrounds, e.g . , a red jacket slowly turns orange [ 11 , 48 , 17 ] .
blocks.zh:
近期的视频传播模型产生视觉质量高的短片[1,49,19,40].
自动回转式视频传播模式通过一次生成一个块,利用先前生成的帧来指导每个新块[2,55,11,37,3],将生成扩展到更长的视频.
通过几步蒸馏和存储最近帧的密钥值(KV)缓存,这些模型可以实时生成持续一分钟或更长的视频[48,25,4].
然而,长视频必须保留主题和背景的外观,同时保持丰富的自然运动.
在实践中,在自动递归生成过程中,错误会累积,逐渐改变主体和背景的外观,例如,红色夹克会慢慢变成橙色[11,48,17].

blocks.en:
One reason for this drift lies in how these models are trained.
LongLive [ 48 ] , for example, uses distribution matching distillation (DMD) [ 54 ] , which matches the distribution of generated video clips within short windows.
However, this objective does not explicitly require subjects and backgrounds to retain their earlier appearance.
A generated clip can therefore look realistic and receive a low distillation loss even if its appearance has gradually drifted.
blocks.zh:
这种漂移的一个原因是这些模型是如何训练的.
例如,LongLive [48] 使用分布匹配蒸馏(DMD)[54],匹配短窗口内生成的视频片段的分布.
然而,这一目标没有明确要求主体和背景保留其先前的出现.
生成的剪辑因此可以看起来现实,即使其外观已逐渐漂移,也会得到较低的蒸馏损失.

blocks.en:
Existing methods address this problem by allowing the model to access more of its generation history.
Some preserve the first frames as an attention sink [ 45 , 48 ] , while others compress older frames [ 51 ] or retrieve relevant information from previously generated content [ 10 , 17 ] .
However, previously generated frames may already contain appearance errors, so attending to them can propagate drift.
The first frames are free of such errors, but stronger attention to them can freeze the motion [ 21 ] .
blocks.zh:
现有方法通过让模型访问更多的其世代历史来解决这一问题.
有些保留了第一个帧作为注意沉淀[45,48],而另一些则压缩旧帧[51]或从先前生成的内容中检索相关信息[10,17].
然而,先前生成的帧可能已经包含外观错误,因此关注它们可以传播漂移.
第一帧没有这样的错误,但更注意它们可以冻结运动[21].

blocks.en: To reduce the drift of subjects and backgrounds without sacrificing motion, we propose Reference Forcing (Figure 2 ), which combines two complementary designs.
blocks.zh: 为了在不牺牲运动的情况下减少主题和背景的漂移,我们提议参考 Forcing(图2),它将两个互补的设计结合起来.

blocks.en:
First, we let each region of a new frame attend to the same region of the initial frames.
We build a teacher that finds these regions with off-the-shelf segmentation and matching models and uses attention masks to force each region to attend only to the same region.
We distill this behavior into a separate attention branch of the student, called the anchor path, which attends only to the initial frames and needs no external models at inference.
The student also learns an anchor gate during distillation, which controls how much each token uses the anchor path, depending on whether its content appears in the initial frames.
blocks.zh:
首先,我们让新框架的每个区域都关注最初框架的同一区域。
我们建立了一个教师,找到这些拥有现成分化和匹配模型的区域,并使用注意面具迫使每个区域只参加同一个区域。
我们把这个行为提炼成学生的一个单独的关注分支,称为锚路径,它只用于初始帧,不需要外部模型推论.
学生在蒸馏过程中还学习了锚门,根据内容是否出现在初始框中,该锚门控制每个信使使用锚门路径的多少.

blocks.en:
Second, we correct the drift already stored in the KV cache.
The recent frames may already have drifted, and later frames continue from them.
For each token of a recent frame, our training-free value correction finds the token in the initial frames that shows the same content.
It then moves the cached value of the token toward the value of that token, by the anchor gate learned in distillation.
blocks.zh:
第二,我们纠正了已经存储在 KV 缓存中的漂移.
最近的帧可能已经漂移,后来的帧会继续从中漂移.
对于最近一个框架的每个标志,我们的无训练值校正在显示相同内容的初始框中找到该标志.
然后通过蒸馏过程中学到的锚门,将该信物的缓存值移动到该信物的值上。

blocks.en:
We evaluate Reference Forcing on long videos generated from MovieGenBench [ 32 ] prompts and compare it with existing long-video generation methods.
Reference Forcing achieves the highest subject and background consistency.
It maintains motion dynamics and visual quality comparable to the base model.
Figure 1 shows that it also generates two-hour videos in one pass, with subject and background consistency that stays stable over the two hours.
blocks.zh:
我们评价从MovieGen Bench[32]生成的长视频的参考强制,
引用强制实现最高的主题和背景一致性.
它保持运动动力学和视觉质量与基模型相当.
图1显示,它还生成一个通行证的两小时视频,主题和背景一致,在两个小时内保持稳定.

blocks.en: Our contributions are summarized as follows: • We propose region-guided distillation for long video generation. We build a teacher that uses off-the-shelf models and attention masks to make each region of a new frame attend to the same region of the initial frames, and distill it into an anchor path of the student, which removes these models and their cost at inference. • We introduce value correction, a training-free method for autoregressive video models that corrects the drifted values in the KV cache toward the matching values of the drift-free initial frames. • Extensive experiments show that Reference Forcing achieves state-of-the-art subject and background consistency, and ablation studies show that each of its components and design choices is needed to improve consistency while keeping the motion of the base model.
blocks.zh: • 我们的贡献概述如下: 我们提议为长视频制作提供区域指导蒸馏。 我们建立了一个教师,使用现成的模型和注意力罩,使每个新框架的区域都关注最初框架的同一区域,并将其蒸馏成学生的锚路,从而消除这些模型及其推论的成本。 我们引入了数值校正,一种对自动递归的视频模型进行训练的免费方法,该方法将KV缓存中的漂移值校正到无漂移初始帧的匹配值. · 广泛的实验表明,参考福尔奇实现最先进的主题和背景一致性,而启示研究显示,其每个组成部分和设计选择都需要在保持基模型运动的同时提高一致性.

blocks.en: We propose region-guided distillation for long video generation. We build a teacher that uses off-the-shelf models and attention masks to make each region of a new frame attend to the same region of the initial frames, and distill it into an anchor path of the student, which removes these models and their cost at inference.
blocks.zh: 我们提议为长视频制作提供区域指导蒸馏。 我们建造一个教师,使用现成的模型和注意力面具,让每个新框架的区域都关注同一个初始框架的区域,然后把它蒸馏成学生的主锚路径,这样就可以消除这些模型及其推论的成本.

blocks.en: We introduce value correction, a training-free method for autoregressive video models that corrects the drifted values in the KV cache toward the matching values of the drift-free initial frames.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了数值校正,一种对自动递归的视频模型进行训练的免费方法,该方法将KV缓存中的漂移值校正到无漂移初始帧的匹配值.

blocks.en: Extensive experiments show that Reference Forcing achieves state-of-the-art subject and background consistency, and ablation studies show that each of its components and design choices is needed to improve consistency while keeping the motion of the base model.
blocks.zh: 广泛的实验表明,参考福尔奇实现最先进的主题和背景一致性,而衰减研究表明,其每个组件和设计选择都需要在保持基模型运动的同时提高一致性.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Diffusion and flow-based models [ 59 , 8 , 35 , 31 , 42 , 23 , 27 ] generate high-quality video clips of several seconds [ 1 , 49 , 19 , 61 , 32 , 40 ] , and earlier work extends them to longer videos by hierarchical generation or noise rescheduling [ 52 , 33 , 16 , 6 ] .
Autoregressive video diffusion generates frames causally and can continue a video beyond its training length [ 2 , 14 , 37 , 3 , 57 ] .
Building on few-step distillation [ 36 , 38 , 54 , 53 ] , recent models distill a bidirectional teacher into a few-step causal student [ 55 , 11 , 62 , 24 ] and extend the rollout to minutes [ 25 , 4 , 48 ] , with objectives computed on windows of a few seconds.
Knowledge distillation [ 7 , 22 ] also admits teachers with privileged inputs that are unavailable at test time [ 28 ] : our teacher uses segmentation [ 26 , 18 , 34 ] and optical flow [ 41 ] , and the student learns its effect through an additional attention path with low-rank adaptation [ 9 ] , so it needs neither at test time.
blocks.zh:
传播与流体模型[59,8,35,31,42,23,27]生成数秒的高质量视频剪辑[1,49,19,61,32,40],早期的作品通过分级生成或噪声重排,将其扩展至较长的视频[52,33,16,6].
自动后退式视频传播可因果生成帧,并可以延续超过训练长度的视频[2,14,37,3,57].
在几步蒸馏法[36,38,54,53]的基础上,最近的模型将一位双向教师蒸馏成一个几步因果学生[55,11,62,24],并将推出扩展至分钟[25,4,48],目标计算在几秒钟的窗口上.
知识蒸馏[7,22] 也接纳了在测试时无法获得的特权投入的教师[28]: 我们的教师使用分化[26,18,34]和光学流[41],学生通过附加关注路径学习其效果,低排名的适应[9],因此在测试时也不需要.

blocks.en:
Language models keep long contexts in a bounded cache through attention sinks, token eviction, or segment memories [ 45 , 58 , 5 , 44 ] .
Long video generators adopt similar mechanisms: a frame sink [ 48 ] , a deeper and compressed sink [ 51 ] , positional re-indexing [ 50 ] , evolving memory tokens [ 17 ] , retrieved history [ 10 , 21 ] , and memory indexed by camera viewpoint [ 46 , 56 ] , all placing the history in the same softmax.
History Forcing [ 20 ] distills the difference between teacher predictions with and without extra history.
Reference Forcing attends to the first frames in a separate attention and corrects the values of the recent window.
blocks.zh:
语言模型通过注意力汇、象征性驱逐或片段记忆[45、58、5、44],在有限度的缓存中保持较长的语境。
长视频生成器采用类似机制:帧槽[48],更深压缩槽[51],位置重索引[50],进化内存符号[17],检索历史[10,21],用相机视角索引内存[46,56],均将历史置于同一软度.
历史推论 [20] 提炼出教师预测与无额外历史的区别.
引用强制在单独的注意中处理第一个帧,并校正最近窗口的值.

blocks.en:
Reference Forcing builds on a frozen autoregressive video generation model, such as LongLive [ 48 ] or Self-Forcing [ 11 ] , and preserves the appearance of the first chunk while new content and motion evolve (Figure 2 ).
After reviewing the KV cache (Section 3.1 ), we add an anchor path that attends to the first chunk (Section 3.2 ), train it by distilling a teacher with masked attention (Section 3.3 ), and correct the drifted values in the recent cache with value correction (Section 3.4 ).

blocks.en: 3.2 Anchor Attention
blocks.zh: 3.2 锁定注意

blocks.en:
The most direct way to improve consistency is to raise the attention to the first chunk, which has not drifted.
In the native attention, however, the first chunk and the recent chunks share one softmax, so this takes weight from the recent chunks, which carry the context for motion, and trades motion for consistency (Section 5.2 ).
We therefore introduce an independent anchor path , which attends to the first chunk without changing the attention to the recent chunks.
blocks.zh:
提高一致性的最直接方式是引起对尚未漂移的第一个块的注意。
然而,在本土的注意力中,第一个块和最近的块共用一个软马克,因此这从最近块中汲取了权重,这些块带有运动的上下文,并用运动来交换一致性(第5.2节)。
因此,我们引入了一条独立的锚地路径,这条路径处理第一个块,而不改变对最近块的关注。

Intuitively, the anchor path lets each token attend to the tokens of the first chunk that show the same content and add their appearance to its output.
In Figure 2 (b), for example, the astronaut attends to the astronaut in the first chunk, and a patch of the ground attends to the same patch of the ground.
The query q ~ \tilde{q} , the keys K ~ 0 \tilde{K}_{0} , and the mask M M , which is 0 0 where the token may attend and − ∞ -\infty elsewhere, decide which tokens it attends to, and the anchor gate w ∈ [ 0 , 1 ] w\in[0,1] decides how much it adds.
The gate is needed because content that appears later, such as a subject entering the frame, has no matching region in the first chunk.
Attending to the first chunk would copy unrelated appearance onto it, so the gate closes ( w ≈ 0 w\approx 0 ) and leaves it to the native attention.

We build on LongLive -1.3B [ 48 ] and keep all of its weights frozen.
Only the anchor path is trained (Section 3.3 ), for 20,000 steps.
The training data are 60-second videos generated mainly by LongLive for 2,000 prompts from MovieGenBench and VidProM [ 43 ] , which exclude the test prompts and prompts close to them in meaning.
Each training sample is one chunk of such a video with the cache used to generate it, and the teacher masks are computed on the clean chunk before it is noised.
We additionally test Self-Forcing 1.3B [ 11 ] , on which the anchor path is distilled again. 1 1 1 Self-Forcing is distilled on 5-second clips and cannot generate long videos on its own, so we adapt Reference Forcing to it by adding a sink. blocks.en: To evaluate overall consistency, motion, and frame quality, we use six dimensions of VBench-Long [ 12 , 13 ] and their average rank [ 10 ] : Subject consistency and background consistency measure whether the appearance of the subject and of the background stays the same over the video, by comparing the features of each frame with those of the first and the previous frame. Motion smoothness measures whether the motion is smooth and free of jitter, and dynamic degree measures how much the video moves. Aesthetic quality and imaging quality measure the visual appeal of each frame and its distortions, such as noise and blur, with the aesthetic and image-quality predictors of VBench-Long [ 12 , 13 ] .
blocks.zh: 为了评价整体一致性、运动性和框架质量,我们采用了V Bench-Long[12、13]的六个维度及其平均等级[10]: 主题一致性和背景一致性通过将每个帧的特征与第一帧和前帧的特征进行比较,在视频上衡量主体和背景的外观是否保持不变. 运动平滑度测量运动是否平滑且没有焦躁,动态度测量视频的移动程度. 美学质量和成像质量用V Bench-Long[12,13]的美学和图像质量预测器测量每个帧的视觉吸引力及其扭曲,如噪音和模糊.

blocks.en:
To measure long-horizon consistency, we compute the DINOv2 [ 30 ] similarity of the subject in each frame to the subject in the first frame (following VBench), and likewise for the background, and average the subject similarity over the last 20 seconds of the 60-second videos, which we call L-Consistency (L-Cons.).
To see how consistency evolves, we further plot both similarities over 120-second videos of the same prompts (like Figure 4 ).
We measure motion by the tracking strength of MiraBench [ 15 ] . 2 2 2 Unlike the dynamic degree of VBench-Long, which is computed from optical flow, tracking strength does not mistake the appearance change of a drifting subject for motion [ 29 ] .
blocks.zh:
为了衡量长距离一致性,我们计算出每个帧中DINov2 [30] 主题与第一帧中的主题的相似性(跟随V Bench),同样也计算出背景,在60秒视频的最后20秒里平均这个主题的相似性,我们称之为L-一致性(L-cons.
要了解一致性是如何演变的,我们进一步描绘了120秒以上同一提示的视频(如图4)的相似之处。
我们用米拉·本奇的追踪力测量运动 [15] 2 2 2个 与V Bench-Long的动态度不同,追踪强度不会将漂移对象的外观变化误判为运动[29].

blocks.en:
To compare the consistency, motion, and quality of the generated videos as people perceive them, we conduct a user study [ 60 , 22 ] and a pairwise evaluation with a vision-language model (VLM, Claude Opus 5.5) under the same two-alternative forced-choice (2AFC) protocol, following Deep Forcing [ 51 ] .
We recruit 7 participants under IRB approval, each of whom watches the 60-second videos of Reference Forcing and of one other method for the same prompt, shown side by side in random order, and chooses the better one overall and in consistency, motion, and quality.
The VLM judge answers the same questions.
blocks.zh:
为了比较所生成的视频在人们眼中的一致性、运动和质量,我们进行了用户研究[60,22],并用视觉语言模型(VLM, Claude Opus 5.5)进行了双向评价,采用相同的双向强制选择(2AFC)协议,沿用了Deep Forcing [51].
在IRB的批准下,我们招募了7名参与者,他们每人观看60秒的参考强制录影带和另外一种方法进行同样的快速录影带,随机排列地并列显示,并选择一个整体上更好的,一致的,运动的,质量的.

blocks.en: 5.2 Ablation Study
blocks.zh: 5.2 阅读研究

blocks.en:
We measure each variant by how much it changes L-Consistency and tracking strength relative to LongLive .
Both metrics are needed, since a video can also stay close to its first frame by moving less.
As shown in Figure 6 , Reference Forcing is the only variant that raises consistency substantially while keeping the motion of LongLive .
blocks.zh:
我们测量每个变体 相对于LongLive的L-一致性和跟踪强度
需要两种衡量标准,因为视频也可以通过少移动来接近其第一个帧.
如图6所示,参考福尔奇是唯一在保持LongLive运动的同时大大提高一致性的变体。

blocks.en:
To measure what each component contributes, we add the anchor path and value correction to LongLive one at a time.
As shown in Figure 6 (a), the two components are complementary.
Added to LongLive alone, the anchor path raises consistency but reduces motion ( − 15.5 % -15.5\% ), and value correction slightly increases motion but raises consistency less.
Together, they double the gain of either component (L-Consistency + 0.097 +0.097 against + 0.044 +0.044 and + 0.034 +0.034 ) while keeping the motion of LongLive .
The two act on different sources of drift.
The anchor path brings the appearance of the first chunk into the current chunk, while value correction removes the drift in the recent cache.
blocks.zh:
为了衡量每个组件的贡献,我们一次将锚定路径和价值校正加入LongLive one.
如图6(a)所示,这两个组成部分是相辅相成的。
仅加入LongLive,锚定路径提高一致性但减少运动(−15.5% -15.5\%),数值校正略微增加运动,但提高一致性较少.
它们加在一起,将任一元件的增益加倍(L-一致性+0.097+0.097对+0.044+0.044和+0.034+0.034),同时保持LongLive的运动.
两种行为对不同的漂移来源.
主锚路径将第一个块的外观带入当前块,而值校正则去除最近缓存中的漂移.

blocks.en:
To find how the anchor path should be trained, we compare it with variants that skip distillation, distill into the native attention, or use a teacher with only part of its mask or none.
As Figure 6 (b) shows, the anchor path keeps the motion only when it is distilled from the masked teacher into its own softmax.
Without distillation, the anchor path reduces motion and raises consistency less (tracking strength − 24.8 % -24.8\% , L-Consistency + 0.064 +0.064 ).
Distilling the same teacher into the native attention gives the highest consistency but reduces motion significantly ( − 35.9 % -35.9\% ), because the first chunk and the recent window then share one softmax, and any attention given to the first chunk is taken from the recent window, which carries the motion.
A teacher without a mask reduces motion as much ( − 36.9 % -36.9\% ), because new content then also attends to the first chunk and is pulled toward its appearance.
Keeping only the subject mask or only the background flow preserves the motion but raises consistency much less ( + 0.031 +0.031 and + 0.036 +0.036 against + 0.097 +0.097 ), so both parts of the mask are needed.
blocks.zh:
为了找到锚道应该如何训练,我们把它与那些跳过蒸馏器,蒸馏器进入本土注意力的变体相比较,或者用一个只有部分面具或者没有面具的老师.
如图6(b)所示,主锚路径只当运动从蒙面老师蒸馏成自己的软马克斯时才能保持运动.
不蒸馏,锚道减少运动,提高一致性较少(跟踪强度−24.8%−24.8\%,L-一致性+0.064+0.064).
将同一个老师分散到本地的注意力中,具有最高的一致性,但大大降低了运动(-35.9%-35.9\%),因为第一个块和最近的窗口然后共享一个软max,对第一个块的任何注意都来自最近的窗口,它带有运动。
没有面具的老师会减少运动(−36.9%-36.9\%),因为新的内容随后也涉及第一个块,并被拉到它的外表。
只保留题面罩或只保留背景流可以保持运动,但提高一致性则要少得多(+0.031+0.031和+0.036+0.036对+0.097+0.097),因此面具的两个部分都需要.

blocks.en:
To test how value correction should be designed, we vary its strength, whether it also changes the keys, and which recent chunk it corrects.
As Figure 6 (c) shows, replacing w w with a constant strength or a subject mask from segmentation gives about the same consistency but reduces motion ( − 25.9 % -25.9\% and − 17.7 % -17.7\% ), because both also correct content that should move.
Correcting the keys as well lowers consistency without changing motion, so changing only the values is enough.
Correcting the newest chunk X n − 1 X_{n-1} , alone or with X n − 2 X_{n-2} , raises consistency further but causes flicker (Figure 6 ).
blocks.zh:
为了测试如何设计数值校正,我们改变它的强度,它是否也改变键,以及它最近修正的块。
如图6(c)所示,用固定强度或分化的标本面具取代 w w 具有相同的一致性,但会减少运动(− 25.9% - 25.9\%和− 17.7% - 17.7\%),因为两者都应该移动的正确内容。
校正键以及降低一致性而不改变运动,所以只改变值就足够了.
单独或用X n − 2 → {n-2}纠正最新块 X n − 1 → {n-1},进一步提高一致性,但引起闪烁(图6)。

blocks.en:
Overall, three choices keep the motion of Reference Forcing : the anchor path has its own softmax, value correction leaves the newest chunk untouched, and its strength follows w w .
Replacing any of them reduces motion by 16–36% relative to LongLive .
blocks.zh:
总的来说,有三种选择保留了引用强制运动 : 主锚路径有它自己的软马克斯,值校正让最新的块未受影响,其强度跟随 w w.
取代其中任何一种,相对于LongLive,运动减少16-36%。

blocks.en: 5.3 Analysis
blocks.zh: 5.3 分析

blocks.en:
The anchor gate w w decides which tokens use the anchor path.
To check whether w w opens for the right tokens, we measure it on held-out teacher videos, where the masks of the teacher mark which tokens should use the anchor path.
As shown in the right panel of Figure 7 , w w is high on the subject and low on content that does not appear in the first chunk.
On videos generated by Reference Forcing (left panel), w w follows the subject as it moves and stays low on content that appears later.
The anchor path is thus used mostly by content that also appears in the first chunk, which is why w w also sets the strength of value correction (Section 3.4 ).
blocks.zh:
锚门 ww 决定哪个符使用锚路.
为了检查ww是否打开正确的标志,我们用被搁置的老师视频来测量它,在那里,老师标记的面具应该使用哪个标志的锚路.
如图7的右面板所示,w在主题上是高的,在第一个块中没有出现的内容上是低的.
在Reference Forcing(左面板)生成的视频上,w跟随主题移动,并低调地记录后来出现的内容.
因此,锚定路径主要被同样出现在第一个块中的内容所使用,这就是 ww 也设置值校正强度的原因(第3.4节.

blocks.en:
To test how sensitive Reference Forcing is to the strength of the anchor path, we multiply its fixed scale γ \gamma (Eq. ( 2 ), Section 3.2 ) by factors from 0.25 to 2, with 1 as the default.
As shown in the top of Figure 8 , a larger γ \gamma overall raises the subject, background, and long-range consistency and lowers both motion metrics.
The default lies in the middle of the resulting trade-off between consistency and motion (top right).
In the examples (bottom), a small γ \gamma leads to severe drift, while a large γ \gamma nearly freezes the scene.
blocks.zh:
为了测试参考强制对锚路径强度的敏感度,我们将固定尺度 γ\gamma(Eq. (2),第3.2节)乘以系数从0.25乘以2, 1作为默认值.
如图8的顶部所示,一个较大的 γ\gamma 总体提高主题,背景,以及远程一致性和降低两个运动度量.
缺省在于由此产生的一致性和运动(右上方)之间的权衡。
在例子(底部)中,一个小QQ\gamma会导致严重的漂移,而一个大QQ\gamma几乎冻结了现场.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion and Limitations
blocks.zh: 6. 结论和限制

blocks.en:
We presented Reference Forcing, which keeps long videos consistent with their initial frames while preserving motion.
A teacher uses off-the-shelf models and attention masks to make each region of a new frame attend to the same region of the initial frames, and we distill it into an anchor path with a learned anchor gate, which needs no external models at inference.
Value correction further moves the drifted values in the KV cache toward the matching values of the initial frames.
Reference Forcing achieves the highest subject and background consistency on LongLive while keeping its motion, and its advantage grows with video length.
blocks.zh:
我们提出了参考强制, 它保持长视频 符合他们的初始框架 同时保持运动。
老师使用现成的模型和注意力面具,使每个新帧区域都关注初始帧的同一区域,我们把它蒸馏成一个有学识的锚门的锚道,这在推论上不需要外部模型.
数值校正将 KV 缓存中的漂移值进一步移动到初始帧的匹配值上 。
参考 forcing在保持运动的同时在LongLive上实现了最高的主题和背景一致性,其优势随着视频长度的增长而增加.

blocks.en:
Reference Forcing uses only the first chunk as reference, so content that first appears later, such as an object that enters the scene, has no reference, and updating the reference during generation is left for future work.
Imaging quality remains slightly below that of LongLive, as the anchor path averages over the matched region of the first chunk and can smooth fine textures slightly.
Scenes with several similar subjects remain difficult, because the segmentation used by the teacher follows a single subject.
The teacher also relies on a detector to find the subject in the first chunk.
If the detector finds no subject, the teacher treats the whole frame as background and matches it by optical flow.
This mostly happens in scenes without a main subject, such as landscapes or crowds.
blocks.zh:
引用强制只使用第一个块作为参考,所以最早出现于后面的内容,如进入场景的物体,没有参考,在生成期间更新参考留给未来工作.
成像质量仍然略低于LongLive,因为锚点路径平均在第一块的匹配区域上空,可以略微平滑细纹理.
几个类似科目的场景仍然很困难,因为老师采用的分门别类的课目都遵循单一科目.
老师还依靠探测器在第一个块中找到这个课题.
如果探测器发现没有题材,老师将整个框架当作背景,并通过光学流来匹配.
这大多发生在没有主体的场景中,如景观或人群.

blocks.en: Appendix A Method Details
blocks.zh: 附录A 方法细节

blocks.en: A.1 Training
blocks.zh: A.1 培训

blocks.en:
We collect 2,000 training prompts, 790 from MovieGenBench and 1,210 from VidProM [ 43 ] .
We exclude the 128 test prompts and the prompts whose CLIP text embedding has a cosine similarity of at least 0.8 to one of them.
We also exclude VidProM prompts that require rendered text or logos or that name real people or brands.
All training prompts are rewritten with Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct [ 47 ] and the prompt-extension template of Wan2.1 [ 40 ] .
blocks.zh:
我们收集了2,000个训练提示,790个来自MovieGen Bench,1 210个来自VidProM [43].
我们排除128个测试提示和提示,其CLIP文本嵌入的余弦相似性至少为0.8到其中之一.
我们还排除了维德ProM提示,这些提示要求制作文本或标志,或给真人或品牌取名.
所有训练提示使用Quen2.5-7B-Instruct [47] 和 Wan2.1 [40] 的即时扩展模板重写.

blocks.en:
The anchor path uses γ = 0.1 \gamma=0.1 and LoRA of rank 16 on the query and the keys.
The native-attention student of Section 5.2 trains a rank-16 LoRA on the query and key projections of the native attention, at the same three denoising steps and with the same data and schedule.
blocks.zh:
主锚路径使用 γ = 0.1\gamma=0.1 和 16 级的 LORA 在查询和键上.
第5.2节的土著留学生根据土著留心的询问和关键预测,在相同的三个去名步骤以及同样的数据和时间表,培训了一名16级的留心学生。

blocks.en:
In one training step, we noise X n X_{n} to x t x_{t} , the teacher predicts the velocity from ( x t , t , 𝒞 n ) (x_{t},t,\mathcal{C}_{n}) with its mask M M , the student predicts it from the same input with M = 0 M=0 , and we update θ \theta with Eq. ( 3 ).
Each sample is noised to the three levels at which the anchor path is used ( t = 750 t=750 , 500, and 250), with one optimizer step per level.
We use AdamW with a learning rate of 10 − 4 10^{-4} , no weight decay, and gradient clipping at 1, and train for 20,000 steps with one sample per step.

在一次训练中,我们发出X n X_{n}到x t x_{t},老师预测速度从 (x t, t, C n) (x _{t}, t,\ mathcal{C}_{n}) 带着它的面具 M M , 学生从同样的输入中预测, M = 0 M = 0, 我们用 Eq ( 3) 更新 \theta 。

blocks.en: A.2 Teacher
blocks.zh: A.2 教师

blocks.en:
We detect the subject named in the prompt with Grounding DINO [ 26 ] and segment it with SAM 2 [ 34 ] , on the first frame of the first chunk and on one frame of each training chunk.
A token belongs to the subject if at least half of its pixels lie in the mask.
A subject token of the current chunk attends only to the subject tokens of the first chunk, among which the attention selects the matching part by content.
If the first chunk has no subject, the whole frame is treated as background.
blocks.zh:
我们用地表DINO探测到在提示中命名的主体,然后用SAM 2 [34] 进行分割,在第一块的第一框和每个训练块的一个框上进行。
如果至少一半的像素位于面具中,则属于对象的符号.
当前块的主题符号只涉及第一个块的主题符号,其中注意按内容选择匹配部分.
如果第一个块没有标的,则整个框作为背景处理.

blocks.en:
We compute optical flow with RAFT [ 41 ] in both directions between a frame of the current chunk and the middle frame of the first chunk, and keep the pixels that pass a forward-backward consistency check.
A background token whose pixels are mostly kept attends to the background tokens of the first chunk around the point that its center maps to.
Background tokens without such a match, and objects that enter later, are not visible in the first chunk and do not use the anchor path.
blocks.zh:
我们用RAFT [41] 计算当前块的框架和第一个块的中间框之间的光学流量,并保持通过向后一致性检查的像素。
一个背景符号,其像素大多保存在它的中心地图所在点周围的第一块的背景符号。
没有这种匹配的背景符号和以后输入的对象在第一个块中不可见,也不使用锚定路径.

blocks.en: A.3 Value Correction
blocks.zh: A.3 数值校正

blocks.en:
Value correction matches tokens by the keys that the model itself computes, so it needs no external model at inference.
For each token, we take its keys before RoPE in the middle blocks of the model (blocks 13 to 18 of 30), normalize them in each block, and concatenate them into one feature.
A token of the recent chunk and a token of the first chunk are matched if each is the most similar token to the other under the cosine similarity of these features.
Tokens without such a match keep their values.
blocks.zh:
值校正通过模型本身计算出来的密钥匹配符号,因此不需要外部模型推论.
对于每个令牌,我们先在模型的中间块(13至18区块30)的ROPE中取其键,使每个块的键常态化,并将其组合成一个特征.
如果每个符号在这些特性的余弦相似性下与另一个符号最相似,则匹配最近块的符号和第一个块的符号。
没有这种匹配的托肯斯保留他们的价值观.
